description: Provenance of the sources and inputs of the whitham-highest-wave package. 'origin' states where a file comes from; 'sha256_at_import' is the hash of the file when it entered this package from the authors' working repository, before the listed edits. The code written in 2026 was produced with the assistance of large language models, as stated in the paper, and checked by the authors.
